unit_of_record: One published study (a paper). n_patients counts patients within it; same_patient_as links papers describing the same patient.
inclusion_criteria: A serious psychiatric syndrome resolved or substantially improved.
The resolution was incidental: the triggering event or treatment was aimed at something else, or not aimed at all.
Individual patients or small series; lesion series allowed when built on individual cases.
Discoveries that were unexpected when reported but are established since stay in, labelled 'Known now'. Findings that later failed controlled testing are labelled 'Refuted'.

tier.A: Strong: high yield or well documented
tier.C: Logged: qualifies, but weak, abstract-only or flagged

era.novel: Still unexplained: nothing comparable established since
era.emerging: Emerging: similar cases, pooled data or trials, not yet settled
era.known: Known now: unexpected when reported, established since
